_comment: Beliefs distilled from five industry points of view. Industry names are deliberately generic. 'apply' maps industry id -> how the belief plays out there; a missing key dims that industry.

beliefs.title: Find the business's core learning problem first
beliefs.why: Every industry has one quantity whose improvement compounds. AI earns its budget by moving that number, not by adding a chatbot.

apply.medtech: Yield is a learning problem: each device built carries data on why the next will pass or fail.
apply.energy: The forecast is the product. Weather, load and price forecasts sit under every trade and dispatch.
apply.minerals: In a ramp-up, AI's first job is to shorten the learning curve on yield and time to qualification.
apply.agri: Decades of trial and field data are the science; the job is making them compound across seasons.

beliefs.title: Context is the moat; models are a commodity
beliefs.why: Everyone can rent a frontier model. What is scarce is trusted, permissioned, versioned context an agent can act on.

apply.building: A shared context layer is the direct answer to what should be centralized.
apply.minerals: Map data to the process it describes; structured and unstructured knowledge behind one permission model.
apply.agri: Model choice should be a routing decision you can change in an afternoon. The context layer is the center of gravity.

beliefs.title: Govern by design, so the safe path is the fast path
beliefs.why: Controls belong in the platform: identity, guardrails, logging and change control, not a review gate at the end.

apply.medtech: Validated by design: locked model versions and risk-based assurance built into the platform.
apply.energy: Grid, markets and ratemaking each carry their own rules; the platform enforces them.
apply.minerals: Process IP is the crown jewel, and every architecture choice is tested against leaking it.
apply.agri: Autonomy is a permission earned per workflow, never a setting you turn on.

beliefs.title: Risk-tier every model
beliefs.why: A meeting summarizer and a model that sets a process parameter do not deserve the same review. Proportion is what lets you move fast where it is safe.

apply.medtech: Four tiers, from direct product-quality impact (full validation) down to productivity tools.
apply.energy: A model that shapes a market offer or a rate filing gets a different review from a summarizer.
apply.minerals: Tiered review from email assistants to models recommending furnace setpoints.
apply.agri: Authority tiers decide what an agent may read, propose or execute.

beliefs.title: Build once, reuse many times
beliefs.why: A platform justifies itself only when the fifth team ships in a fraction of the first team's effort.

apply.medtech: Shared data, MLOps and validation first; then every plant and planner reuses them.
apply.building: If the same capability is rebuilt in three teams, that is a platform gap, not a talent gap.
apply.minerals: Composable and compostable: modular parts, each replaceable in 18 months.
apply.agri: Golden paths: the first delivery is a paved road with one solution on it.

beliefs.title: Central standards, federated delivery
beliefs.why: The enterprise owns architecture, security and reusable platforms. Business units own their data and outcomes. The line is drawn explicitly.

apply.energy: A federated organization with one standard and clear decision rights.
apply.building: Centralize the rules of the road; federate ownership of domain data.
apply.agri: Explicit RACI between the platform team and the domains it serves.

beliefs.title: Measure value created, not models built
beliefs.why: A model matters only when it changes a decision: a bid, a work order, a capital plan. Start from the decision and its owner.

apply.medtech: Forecasts are measured in procedures served; a stockout is a delayed procedure.
apply.energy: Decisions, not models. Every initiative names the decision it changes.
apply.building: Adoption, quality, reuse and speed, each traced to margin, revenue or customer outcome.
apply.agri: Evaluation is the product, not the QA step.

beliefs.title: Every answer has a token bill
beliefs.why: Inference cost per agentic workflow is rising. The harness, caching and routing matter more than the model's horsepower.

apply.building: Most of the token bill is avoidable with context, caching and routing.
apply.agri: Cost control is a platform capability every team inherits for free.
